zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 直接标注与自定义工具栏
changes: 截图选区工具栏直接展示高频标注工具，无需进入额外标注模式；已提交的标注可重新选中、改样式和拖动
工具下方即时出现二级样式栏，提供五档真实粗细预览、预设颜色和按工具适配的尺寸范围
偏好设置可控制工具栏显示项与顺序，并可选择按仅保存在本机的使用频次自动排序
取色器融入正常截图流程，支持跟随预览、单击冻结、双击复制以及右键复制并退出
箭头支持普通与自由绘制模式；自由箭头跟随手势并采用连续、饱满的软带轮廓
应用、Sparkle 更新 ZIP 和手动安装 DMG 均已签名并通过 Apple 公证

en.label: Latest
en.title: Direct annotation and a configurable toolbar
changes: The selection toolbar now exposes frequent annotation tools directly without a separate mode; committed annotations can be reselected, restyled, and moved.
A secondary style palette appears below the active tool with five true-width previews, preset colors, and tool-specific size ranges.
Preferences can control toolbar visibility and order, with optional automatic sorting by usage counts stored only on this Mac.
The color picker is integrated into the regular capture flow with live preview, click-to-freeze, double-click copy, and right-click copy-and-exit.
Arrows support straight and freehand modes; freehand arrows follow the gesture with a continuous, balanced ribbon silhouette.
The app, Sparkle update ZIP, and manual-install DMG are signed and notarized by Apple.
